sections.heading: Core Concepts: Volume of prisms and cylinders

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 8$ in volume of prisms and cylinders, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0$.
A data set recorded for volume of prisms and cylinders consists of the four values $\{15, 19, 23, 29\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $15 + 19 + 23 + 29 = 86$, and dividing by $4$ gives $21.5$.
